title: Act: Implement execution store, handlers and routes
summary: Create execution package and register routes
description: Add execution.go, handler.go and wire into the admin route group.
acceptance_criteria: Illegal state returns ErrIllegalState mapped to 409
Updated record is committed through the Committer

steps.symbol: new: Execution, FileStore, List, Get, Retry, Approve, ErrNotFound, ErrIllegalState
steps.action: Define Status constants QUEUED, RUNNING, AWAITING_APPROVAL, APPROVED, FAILED, COMPLETED and Execution with yaml tags id, world_id, round_id, status, error, updated_at; FileStore{Root, Git gitrepo.Committer, Now}; List reads development/executions/*.yaml sorted by id; Get validates id via safepath.Segment; Retry requires FAILED->QUEUED and clears error; Approve requires AWAITING_APPROVAL->APPROVED; both write atomically and Commit the path
Handler with Service interface{List,Retry,Approve}; List returns JSON array (empty array not null); Retry/Approve read chi param id and map ErrNotFound->404, ErrIllegalState->409, others 500

Build execution.FileStore{Root: cfg.Storage.RepoPath, Git: same gitrepo.CLI, Now: time.Now} and register r.Get("/executions", eh.List), r.Post("/executions/{id}/retry", eh.Retry), r.Post("/executions/{id}/approve", eh.Approve)
steps.expected: Routes are under the admin token group
